note: Banca Intesa's information sheet (enclosure 103) for its Visa Gold credit card: an annual membership fee of 6,000 dinars for the primary card, and a fixed nominal rate of 15.62% a year on spending in dinars.

sources.title: Banca Intesa, Enclosure 103: Visa Gold
sources.said: ENCLOSURE 103 ... For consumption in RSD: 15,62% per year, fixed. ... Credit card issuing fee- annual membership fee 6.000 RSD
